text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- 36 foreign countries to take part in 35th international exhibition at Nabeul south of Tunis from April 25 to May 11.
- Tunisian state-controlled firm STIA assembles 300 buses per year.
- Number of operational oilfields in Tunisia reaches 26.
- Authorities recently closed shops selling products with no mention of place of origin.
- Mediterranean seminar on red meat in Tunis on April 21-23.
